audit.whatIsWrong: FAV / 4/10 matches 54.66% over 805 games and the all-Ornn chart.
audit.why: Locke's kill script needs marks plus his blink; Ornn denies both by existing.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[] carries only 3 entries where 4 are expected — the 2+ item stage had no spike at all.
audit.why: Purgatory executes, and Locke's ultimate text says he gains additional power for sealing champions — so his floor rises with every seal. That is exactly the late-game spike the array was missing.
audit.corrected: spikes[3].text and spikes[3].when created with before:null.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says 'the ten seconds' and 'his E' without ever giving a rank-1 number for anything else.
audit.why: Ashen Pursuit is a flat 10s at every rank — the one cooldown in the kit that never shrinks, which is why the post-blink window is reliable. Soul Ignition is 18s at rank 1 and refunds a portion of the damage he takes during it. Purgatory is 120s at rank 1. His Q is 10s at rank 1 falling to 6s.
audit.corrected: The flat 10s, 18s and 120s written into the phases, the do/don't lines and breakdown.mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization says 'Anti-heal is optional — his sustain is self-refund, not lifesteal.'
audit.why: Grievous Wounds reduces healing from any source, and Soul Ignition heals him at the end of its duration — a self-refund is still healing. Calling anti-heal optional tells the user to skip the item that shortens his sustain window.
audit.corrected: Replaced that clause with a line stating Grievous Wounds cuts the Soul Ignition refund.

edits.after: Ashen Pursuit is online but it is also his only exit, and it is a flat 10s — every trade he takes is one-way.

notes: Locke's kit file carries no ability names at all, so the names on this page could only be checked against the missingInteractions headlines: those confirm Silver Stake (P), Soul Ignition (W), Ashen Pursuit (E) and Purgatory (R). Nothing anywhere confirms 'Ritual Nails' for Q — Riot-style text calls the projectiles 'Soul Nails'. I left every 'Ritual Nails' reference untouched (it appears in focus.text, winCon, enemyWin, loading, dosFull, breakdown.cooldowns and report[3]/report[5]) rather than guess. The page's '125 range' figure for Locke is likewise unverifiable from the kit; left alone.
